title: Signal: Locked restore is switched off for the build
scope: A Directory.Build.props file that declares a `RestorePackagesWithLockFile` switch set to false.
limitations: It matches a `RestorePackagesWithLockFile` switch set to false in the parsed Directory.Build.props; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A Directory.Build.props that mentions a `RestorePackagesWithLockFile` switch set to false in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
